test.query: SELECT sum(clamp(number, toUInt64(100), toUInt64(24999999))) FROM numbers(25000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(clamp( toString(number), repeat('!', 256), repeat('~', 256)))) FROM numbers(2000000) FORMAT Null

WITH range(128) AS lower_bound, arrayMap(x -> x + toUInt64(1000000000), range(128)) AS upper_bound SELECT sum(length(clamp([number], lower_bound, upper_bound))) FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(clamp(number, number, number + toUInt64(1))) FROM numbers(25000000) FORMAT Null
